_about: Every VFL/AFL match of 1990-1999 with its ground and start time, from the Squiggle API (https://api.squiggle.com.au/?q=games;year=<year>, fetched 2026-11-13). 'date' is the local start time as Squiggle gives it (its 'localtime' for these years sits an hour earlier than the clubs' traditional 2:10 pm starts, so 'date' is used).
